whenToUse: The persistent navigation column of an app, which can narrow to an icon rail or slide off screen
Documentation trees with collapsible sections and sub-pages, or project lists narrowed by a search field
A right side inspector that shows the details of the record open beside it

whenNotToUse.when: A complete multi page product layout with header, nav and content area already built
Account settings pages that switch between personal details, billing and team panels
A shop catalog facet panel with price range, brand counts, color swatches and sizes

agentNotes: Menu links are anchors passed through `render` on the base twin and `asChild` on radix; point each # `href` at your route
`SidebarProvider` listens for Cmd or Ctrl+B on the whole window, so pressing it in a text editor on the page toggles its `open` state too
